summary: Refactored the agent-client layer to replace workspace profiles/integrations with per-project gizmo/pi/skill toggles. Updated AgentClient interface, WebSocketAgentClient and FakeAgentClient implementations, AgentStore, and added a parseProjectConfig helper plus new fake state for gizmo/pi overrides and disabled-globally gizmo set. Deleted profile-overrides files and began cleaning up downstream call sites (session-actions, WorkspaceConfigurePanel/AgentSettings pending).
decisions: AgentClient.addProject now takes only projectPath; integrations are managed via setProjectGizmoExtension/setProjectPiExtension instead of constructor arg.
setProjectGizmoExtension and setProjectPiExtension return Promise<ProjectConfig>; setProjectSkill and setGlobalExtension return Promise<ResourceCatalog> (matching server protocol).
Removed WorkspaceProfile/WorkspaceProfiles from the client protocol surface; FakeAgentClient no longer maintains profiles or fakeProfiles helper.
Added parseProjectConfig helper in packages/protocol alongside parseProjectDomains to validate server responses for the new config.
FakeAgentClient tracks per-project gizmo and pi extension enable/disable via Maps and a global disabled-gizmo Set, with #projectConfig(projectPath) building the effective config.
errors: svelte-check reported 41 errors after edits, including undefined 'selectedIntegrations' in AgentStore (fixed by deriving integrations from the selected project), missing WorkspaceProfile/activeProfileId/profiles references in profile-overrides files (deleted), Implicit any on bindings/parameters across remaining callers, and an AgentClient base-property mismatch — remaining errors not yet resolved.
